tools.title: Score one job posting against FILTER.md
tools.description: Score one job posting for the fictional persona Rohan Desai (Java/Spring backend, early career) using the versioned keyword filter in FILTER.md. Give either posting_id (from the saved local snapshot, e.g. 'stripe:8128744') or title+body(+location) as pasted text. Returns keep/reject, the reason, matched words, and each shortlist claim labeled supported / contradicted / insufficient against the posting text. Read-only: no network, no writes.
